1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. How long, Lord, will you continue to ignore me? How long will you pay no attention to me?

2.w: How long must I worry, and suffer in broad daylight? How long will my enemy gloat over me?

3.w: Look at me! Answer me, O Lord my God! Revive me, or else I will die.

4.w: Then my enemy will say, “I have defeated him.” Then my foes will rejoice because I am shaken.

5.w: But I trust in your faithfulness. May I rejoice because of your deliverance.

6.w: I will sing praises to the Lord when he vindicates me.
